title: Patch: the clock alarm covers the mulligan and background tabs

**Issue #4682 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #4682: Patch: the clock alarm covers the mulligan and background tabs
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

You queue, get paired, and switch tabs; today nothing calls you back with sound. Your turn and prompt alarms stay silent in a hidden tab, and the 45-second mulligan countdown never sounds at all. Miss your prompt and the server lets the AI policy answer for you; miss the mulligan and you keep your whole hand unpicked. After this, your own turn, prompt and mulligan countdowns beat in their last seconds whether or not the tab is visible.

## Why

`apps/web/src/game/Clock.tsx` wires the alarm only for `kind === "turn"` and `kind === "prompt"`, and its comment says the mulligan (`side null`) stays silent. `apps/web/src/audio/engine.ts` (`accepting()`) returns false while the page is hidden, so every `playSfx`, including the alarm beats `stepClockAlarm` schedules, is dropped in a hidden tab; the 200ms repaint that schedules them is throttled there too. SPEC R79: on prompt-clock expiry the server answers with the AI policy. SPEC R268: the two mulligans share one 45s clock a player's answer neither stops nor extends. PR #4528 deliberately quieted background tabs (crowd, SFX, voices); PR #4573 added the own-prompt alarm afterwards, so the conflict is new and the alarm's whole job is catching a player who looked away.

## Proposal

Include the viewer's mulligan countdown in the alarm schedule with the same beats. Exempt only the alarm beats (`heartbeat`/`clockTick` from `audio/clockAlarm.ts`) from the hidden-tab gate so a hidden tab still sounds your own clocks, keeping everything else silent. Schedule defensively for throttled repaint: plan beats from the server frame and skip late ones per `CLOCK_ALARM_LATE_MS` as today.

## Where it lands

`apps/web/src/game/Clock.tsx`, `apps/web/src/audio/useTurnClockAlarm.ts`, `apps/web/src/audio/clockAlarm.ts`, `apps/web/src/audio/engine.ts` (plus `constants.ts`), and the tests beside each (`clockAlarm.test.ts`, `engine.test.ts`, `Clock.test.tsx` patterns). No engine or spec rule changes: this presents the existing clocks (SPEC §2.1, §9.5, §10.11).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The viewer's foreground mulligan countdown beats in its last seconds; the opponent's side stays silent.
- [ ] In a hidden tab the viewer's own turn clock and prompt countdown still beat; crowd, effects and voices stay silent.
- [ ] Muted, pre-gesture, or context-less states stay silent exactly as today.
- [ ] Late beats are skipped, never stacked, on return to the tab.
- [ ] The touched vitest files pass (`pnpm --dir apps/web test <file>`); no new lint suppressions.

## Size and risks

Medium: one audio-engine carve-out plus schedule tests. Risk: browsers may suspend a background AudioContext (the engine already tears down closed ones); the tab-title "Your turn" (#1792) remains the fallback. Rejected alternative: desktop notifications (needs permission prompts) and reusing music's `playMusicInBackground` (wrong channel for an alarm).

---

## Plan

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/45364523746)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

After this, the viewer's own turn clock, own prompt countdown, and shared mulligan countdown each beat through their last 30 seconds (`heartbeat`, then sharper `clockTick`), whether or not the tab is visible. Only the two alarm sounds bypass the hidden-tab gate; crowd, effects, and voices stay silent there, and muted, pre-gesture, and context-less states stay silent exactly as today.

## Files to touch

| File | New / change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `apps/web/src/audio/constants.ts` | change | Add `CLOCK_ALARM_SFX: ReadonlySet<SfxId>` naming `"heartbeat"` and `"clockTick"` (CLAUDE.md rule 9; precedent: `RAPID_SFX`, `SCHEDULED_SFX`). |
| `apps/web/src/audio/engine.ts` | change | `accepting()` takes an optional `SfxId`; `playSfx` passes its `id` so only alarm beats skip the hidden check. |
| `apps/web/src/game/Clock.tsx` | change | Third `useTurnClockAlarm` call for the armed mulligan prompt; rewrite the R4562000 comment (lines 421–424) that says the mulligan stays silent. |
| `apps/web/src/audio/clockAlarm.ts` | change | Header comment only: add the shared mulligan countdown (R268) to the turn/prompt wording. |
| `apps/web/src/audio/useTurnClockAlarm.ts` | change | Header comment only: same wording update. |
| `apps/web/src/audio/AudioControls.tsx` | change | Background-music hint names the alarm as the exception. |
| `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json` | change | Same hint's translation, re-keyed to the new English string. |
| `apps/web/src/audio/engine.test.ts` | change | Hidden-tab alarm tests. |
| `apps/web/src/game/Clock.test.tsx` | change | New `R268` mulligan-alarm describe block. |
| `apps/web/src/audio/clockAlarm.test.ts` | change | 45-second mulligan schedule test. |
| `apps/web/src/audio/constants.test.ts` | change | Pin `CLOCK_ALARM_SFX`. |
| `apps/web/src/audio/AudioControls.test.tsx` | change | Update `BACKGROUND_HINT` to the new string. |

Do not touch `crates/`, `apps/edge/`, `apps/admin/`, `e2e/`, `spec/` (no rule change, no new ruling), or `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`. Governing spec: §2.1 (mulligan), §9.5 (clocks/grace), §10.11 (audio settings); rulings R79, R268, R439, R506, R4562000 — all existing, only cited in comments.

## Steps

1. **`apps/web/src/audio/constants.ts`.** After the `CLOCK_ALARM_LATE_MS` line, add:
   `/** #4682: the clock alarm's beats, the only sounds a hidden tab still accepts (engine.ts `accepting`). */`
   `export const CLOCK_ALARM_SFX: ReadonlySet<SfxId> = new Set<SfxId>(["heartbeat", "clockTick"]);`
   Copy the `RAPID_SFX` declaration shape. `SfxId` is already imported.
2. **`apps/web/src/audio/engine.ts`.** Change `function accepting(): boolean` to `function accepting(id?: SfxId): boolean`, and change only its visibility line to:
   `if (visibility() === "hidden" && (id === undefined || !CLOCK_ALARM_SFX.has(id))) return false;`
   Import `CLOCK_ALARM_SFX` from `./constants.ts`. In `playSfx`, change `if (!accepting() || ...)` to `if (!accepting(id) || ...)`. Leave the other five `accepting()` call sites (`startEffect`, `playPickup`, `startNext`, `begin`, `playVoice`) exactly as-is, so muted, disposed, and closed-context refusals still apply to the alarm.
3. **`apps/web/src/game/Clock.tsx`.** After the prompt hook (line 424), add:
   `// R268: the shared mulligan countdown beats like the viewer's own (each client hears its own copy); there is no per-side line to gate on, so the armed mulligan prompt is the gate.`
   `const mulliganRemaining = readout.prompt !== null && readout.prompt.kind === "mulligan" ? readout.prompt.remainingMs : null;`
   `useTurnClockAlarm(mulliganRemaining, mulliganRemaining !== null);`
   Rewrite the lines 421–424 comment to remove "`side === "you"` … and the mulligan (side null), so those stay silent" — it must now say only holderless non-mulligan prompts stay silent. Do not change `TICK_MS`; throttled hidden-tab repaints still land about one beat per reading (each reading's current second plays at once, older ones skip per `CLOCK_ALARM_LATE_MS`).
4. **`apps/web/src/audio/clockAlarm.ts`, `apps/web/src/audio/useTurnClockAlarm.ts`.** Header comments only: extend "the viewer's own turn and prompt clocks (R439, R506, R4562000)" with "and shared mulligan countdown (R268)". No logic change: `planClockAlarm` is kind-agnostic.
5. **`apps/web/src/audio/AudioControls.tsx`.** Change the `playMusicInBackground` hint to exactly:
   `"Off: the music fades out when you switch to another tab or window, and back in when you return. Sound effects and voices stay quiet either way, except your own turn, prompt and mulligan countdown beats."`
   In **`apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json`**, replace the old-English-keyed entry with the new English string as key and value:
   `"关闭：切换到其他标签页或窗口时音乐淡出，回来时再淡入。无论如何，音效和语音都会保持静音，只有你自己的回合、提示和mulligan倒计时的提示音例外。"`
6. **Tests.** Add the tests in §Tests below, mirroring the named patterns (`promptProps` in `Clock.test.tsx`, `rig()`/`unlocked()` in `engine.test.ts`, `countdown()` in `clockAlarm.test.ts`).

## Tests

- `apps/web/src/audio/engine.test.ts`, near the `"B5 while the page is hidden…"` test, using `rig()` + `unlocked(r)` then `r.page.visibility = "hidden"`:
  - `it("hidden: the clock alarm's heartbeat and clockTick are accepted while hidden, everything else refused")` — `playSfx("heartbeat")` and `playSfx("clockTick", { amount: 3 })` return `true` and are logged; `playSfx("draw")` and `playVoice(...)` return `false` with an otherwise empty log; back to `"visible"`, `playSfx("draw")` returns `true`.
  - `it("hidden: muted still refuses the alarm")` — `writeAudioSettings({ muted: true })` plus hidden: `playSfx("heartbeat")` is `false`, log empty.
  - Run: `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/audio/engine.test.ts`
- `apps/web/src/game/Clock.test.tsx`, new `describe("R268 — the viewer's mulligan countdown sounds the clock alarm")` with a `mulliganProps(at, ms)` helper mirroring `promptProps` plus `mulligan: true` and `turnDeadline: null`:
  - `it("R268 the shared mulligan countdown beats like the turn hook")` — 12_300ms then 12_100/11_900/11_300 rerenders give `[["heartbeat", 300], ["heartbeat", 300]]`.
  - `it("R268 a whole 45-second mulligan logs thirty beats, twenty heartbeats then ticks 1 to 10")` — loop `MULLIGAN_CLOCK_MS` down to 0 in 200ms steps; expect exactly 30 beats (proves the opponent side adds no second schedule).
  - `it("R268 resolving resets the schedule, so the next mulligan counts down afresh")` — mirror of the R4562000 reset test with `promptDeadline: null` between.
  - Run: `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/Clock.test.tsx`
- `apps/web/src/audio/clockAlarm.test.ts`:
  - `it("R268 a 45-second mulligan countdown plans beats only for its last 30 seconds")` — `countdown(MULLIGAN_CLOCK_MS, REPAINT_MS)` yields 30 beats, first at second 30, landing on time. Import `MULLIGAN_CLOCK_MS` from `@jackioh/server-config`.
  - Run: `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/audio/clockAlarm.test.ts`
- `apps/web/src/audio/constants.test.ts`: extend the `"R439 pins the turn clock alarm's schedule"` test with `expect([...CLOCK_ALARM_SFX].sort()).toEqual(["clockTick", "heartbeat"])`; add the import. Run: `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/audio/constants.test.ts`
- `apps/web/src/audio/AudioControls.test.tsx`: set `BACKGROUND_HINT` to the new string in §Steps 5 verbatim. Run: `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/audio/AudioControls.test.tsx`
- After all: `cargo jackioh spec check` (comments cite only existing R-ids).

## Done when

- [ ] Viewer's mulligan countdown beats its last 30 seconds; no second per-side schedule.
- [ ] Hidden tab still sounds own turn/prompt/mulligan beats; crowd, effects, voices refused.
- [ ] Muted, pre-gesture, context-less states silent as today; no new lint suppressions.
- [ ] Late beats skipped, never stacked, on return (existing `CLOCK_ALARM_LATE_MS` path, covered by tests).
- [ ] The five vitest files above pass; `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.

## Risks

- A browser may suspend a background `AudioContext`; then `playSfx` logs `suspended: true` and stays silent. Accepted: the tab-title "Your turn" (#1792) remains the fallback, same as every other background sound today.
- Hidden-tab repaint throttles to ~1 Hz, so most beats arrive at their second and play at once (`delayMs: 0`); beats more than `CLOCK_ALARM_LATE_MS` stale are skipped and never stack on return.
- `startNext`/`begin` keep the full gate, so no voice line or queued cue leaks through the alarm carve-out; only `heartbeat`/`clockTick` via `playSfx` are exempt.
- The zh-CN hint wording is mine; a follow-up may adjust phrasing without changing behavior.

## Open questions

None. No person-only step exists: no forbidden paths, secrets, or dashboard settings are involved.
```
